regime_context: The detector is in a defensive, low-breadth rotation: Big Pharma is the headline (PPH) with durability_bar 0.84, breadth 1.0, and a crowding flag (z 1.5), while it is flanked by equal-weight Health Care (XLV) and other defensive/staples groups. Only 17/49 themes are trend-eligible, absorption is weak (0.32), and no single narrative is dominant, so the absolute-trend gate is permissive but concentrated and the cross-sectional rank should be read as a focus lens only.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Big Pharma's headline leadership remains intact without the equal-weight Health Care and Defensives complexes continuing to confirm; a 0.25-unit narrowing in the rotation margin toward the challenger while PPH retains its trend status would retire this watch on the handoff.

theses.subject: Big Pharma
theses.thesis: Big Pharma is the headline theme and is trend-eligible with a high durability_bar (0.84), full breadth (1.0), and a trend Hurst tag. The trend-gate is the only validated edge and it is favorable here; the crowding flag (z 1.5) cautions about sizing, but is not a fade signal.
evidence: headline = Big Pharma, durability_bar 0.84, breadth 1.0, hurst_tag trend
crowded = true at z 1.5 (size-down caution only, not a reversal call)
theses.dissent: The crowding z-score is elevated, and the detector's own guardrails warn that ETF inflows and attention spikes can mark tops; a headline theme with perfect breadth may be late-stage rather than early-cycle.

falsifier.text: PPH breaks below the approximate level that clipped its 10-day trend and fails to re-take it within five sessions

theses.subject: Health Care (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Health Care (Equal-Weight) is trend-eligible with high durability_bar (0.78), strong breadth (0.883), and a trend tag. Its leadership is consistent with the Big Pharma headline, so this lean is more of a confirmation of the prevailing defensive-healthcare theme than an independent call.
evidence: eligible = true, durability_bar 0.78, breadth 0.883, hurst_tag trend
theses.dissent: It is highly correlated with Big Pharma and shares the same crowding risk; the detector's cross-sectional rank has no return-forecast edge.

falsifier.text: XLV lags the S&P 500 by 3% before the check-by date while Big Pharma remains below its own trend level

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: US Energy Complex is trend-eligible with a moderate durability_bar (0.48) but is not crowded (z 0.41), making it one of the few non-defensive leadership themes with constructive trend-gate status in a narrowing tape.
theses.dissent: Lower durability and zero breadth suggest the trend may be narrow and less cohesive; energy is also not part of the dominant macro-narrative flow.

falsifier.text: XLE breaks below its 20-day average and fails to recover that level within a week

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
